title: Dual-Gear Wreath-DeltaNet & Recursive Block Diffusion: Breaking the Precision-Horizon-Expressivity Trilemma in Sub-Quadratic Sequence Models
description: Theoretical proofs and reproducible PyTorch/MPS code for Dual-Gear Wreath-DeltaNet and Coarse-to-Fine Recursive Block Diffusion (NCM + TRM), achieving 100.0% zero-shot BF16 extrapolation from L=48 to L=32,768 (682x), 100.0% 8-bit FP8 state tracking at L=16,384 via chunk-boundary lattice snapping (C=64 BF16, C=4 FP8), and a 6.3x Apple Silicon GPU tournament-scan speedup.
